decisions.reason: As a dedicated sensor module that fits the firm's publicly stated expansion of its modular platform, management is likely to keep backing it and read any weak sales as temporary or niche-specific rather than a reason to exit.

Because this is already a 3.0 replacement of an established measurement module, the firm has strong sunk development and compatibility commitments and would be very reluctant to remove such a core platform building block.
The CAN bus interface supports the firm's automation and embedded use cases, so prior investment and the strategic value of broad connectivity make continued commitment more likely than withdrawal.
A standalone CO2 sensor module is closely aligned with the firm's sensing portfolio and visible product strategy, encouraging management to persist unless failure becomes unmistakable.
